name: IceCube-Gen2 Technical Design Report
notes: The TDR is not on arXiv. arXiv:2308.04141 is an unrelated theory paper and is not this document.
Part PDF URLs are taken from the collaboration's TDR landing page; the PDFs themselves (75 MB and 28 MB) were not downloaded.

summary.plain: The full technical plan for the next-generation South Pole neutrino observatory: what it should measure, how the detectors are designed, and how it would be built on the ice.
summary.technical: Three-part preliminary design of IceCube-Gen2. Part I: science and conceptual design; Part II: detector and performance for the optical, radio and surface arrays, data transfer and calibration; Part III: construction and logistics for 10,000 sensors, 120 holes to 2,600 m and a 500 km² radio array.

volumes.title: Parts I and II: Science and Conceptual Design; Detector and Performance (July 2023)
Part III: Detector Construction and Logistical Support Requirements (June 2024)
